description:
Structured analysis via the local LLM with explicit system/context/instruction separation. The 3-part format prevents context bleed in smaller models - the local LLM acknowledges the context in a fake assistant turn before receiving the instruction.

Good fit when prompt structure matters:
• Code review - paste full source, ask for bugs/improvements
• Comparison - paste two implementations, ask which is better and why
• Refactoring suggestions - paste code, ask for a cleaner version
• Content analysis - paste text, ask for structure/tone/issues
• Any task where separating context from instruction improves clarity

Field guidance (each has a job - keep them focused):
• system: persona + constraints, under 30 words. "Expert Python developer focused on performance and correctness."
• context: COMPLETE data - full source, full logs, full text. Never truncate.
• instruction: exactly what to produce, under 50 words. Specify format: "Return a JSON array of {line, issue, fix}."

Review the output before acting on it - local model capability varies.

context.description: The COMPLETE data to analyse. Full source code, full logs, full text. NEVER truncate.

instruction.description: What to produce. Specify format: "List 3 bugs as bullet points" or "Return a JSON array of {line, issue, fix}".

json_schema.description: Force structured JSON output. Provide a JSON Schema object and the response will be guaranteed valid JSON conforming to it.

max_tokens.description: Response token budget. OMIT THIS - the server sizes it from the live model's context window (25%, e.g. ~32,000 on a 128k-context model). Values below 4,096 are IGNORED (tiny caps strangle reasoning models) and the dynamic budget applies. Only set to raise the ceiling.

model.description: Optional: pin to a specific model id. When set, overrides automatic routing.

seed.description: Deterministic sampling seed - same seed + same prompt → reproducible output. Useful for testing.

stop.description: Stop sequence(s) - generation halts when one is produced (up to 4).

system.description: Persona. Be specific: "Expert Node.js developer focused on error handling and edge cases."

temperature.description: 0.1 for bugs/review, 0.3 for analysis (default), 0.5 for suggestions.

top_k.description: Sample only from the top-K tokens (e.g. 40). 0/omitted = disabled.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling 0–1 (e.g. 0.9). Lower = more focused. Alternative to temperature.

name: custom_prompt
